steps.title: Bem-vindo: Culture - Volume 15
steps.text: In this A2-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Culture". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: Everyone stood for the national anthem.
A handshake is a common greeting there.
It's a tradition in my family to cook together on Sundays.
